news.headline: NeurAxis Announces Medical Coverage Policy Milestone, Expanding Access to Over 18 Million Additional Covered Lives
news.summary: NeurAxis secured new medical policy coverage from a major national health insurer for its PENFS (IB-Stim) therapy, adding roughly 18 million covered lives and pushing the company's total national coverage footprint above 120 million lives. Shares spiked sharply on the news, trading as high as $8.06 the following session versus a pre-announcement level near $5.77.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
news.summary: NeurAxis (NYSE American: NRXS) will webcast a company presentation at 11:45 a.m. ET on September 29, 2026 and hold one-on-one investor meetings through September 30 at the virtual Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, with a replay to follow.

news.headline: NeurAxis, Inc. (NRXS) Presents at iAccess Alpha Virtual Best Ideas Fall Investment Conference 2026
news.summary: Management told investors H1 2026 revenue rose 94% year-over-year to $3.5 million with gross margin at 86%, and said the company is on pace for $7-8 million in full-year 2026 revenue even without further payer wins or H2 growth. NeurAxis now holds nearly 30 medical policies (including Anthem and Blue Cross Blue Shield plans) covering more than 100 million lives.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to $1.93 million on 60% higher unit deliveries, with gross margin improving to 85.9% from 83.6%, driven by the Category I CPT code for PENFS effective January 1, 2026. The quarter's GAAP loss of $0.19/share missed the $0.16 estimate, and the company said it began fielding 10 new 1099 territory sales reps focused on VA hospitals through July 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced four new regional medical policies covering more than 500,000 additional lives in the Mid-Atlantic region. CEO Brian Carrico said the wins broaden patient access "as we continue to make meaningful progress with the nation's largest payers."

news.headline: NeurAxis (NYSE American: NRXS) Trading 9.9% Higher on Heavy Volume
news.summary: Shares extended their post-coverage-news rally, trading up 9.9% intraday to a high of $8.06 (last $7.63) on volume of 516,662 shares, about 280% above the average session volume of 136,034, as investors reacted to the expanded payer coverage announcement.

catalysts.label: Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis management will webcast a company presentation at 11:45 a.m. ET on September 29, 2026, plus host one-on-one investor meetings through September 30. This is a visibility/investor-outreach event rather than a data readout, but comes on the heels of the September payer coverage milestone and could surface updated commercial metrics.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Consensus/exchange calendars point to a Q3 2026 results release around November 9, 2026 (not yet confirmed by an official company press release as of Sept 19). The print will be watched for whether Q3 revenue tracks toward the $7-8M FY2026 guidance reiterated at the September iAccess Alpha conference, unit growth, and updated commentary on the VA sales channel ramp.

catalysts.label: VA channel sales ramp scaling
catalysts.detail: Following the December 2025 VA Federal Supply Schedule contract award, NeurAxis said on its Q2 call that it hired 10 new 1099 territory reps calling on VA hospitals, targeted to be fully in the field by mid-September 2026. Continued VA utilization growth is a key swing factor for H2 2026 and 2027 revenue given the ~7 million VA-eligible patient population.

catalysts.label: Additional national payer coverage decisions
catalysts.detail: Management has flagged that further regional and national payer medical-policy wins (beyond the >120 million covered lives reached in September) are expected to keep arriving through year-end, building on the Category I CPT code that took effect January 1, 2026. Each incremental payer policy directly expands the addressable patient base for PENFS/IB-Stim reimbursement.

pulse: NRXS shares spiked to roughly $8.06 intraday on September 16-17, 2026 after NeurAxis announced a major payer coverage expansion (about 18 million additional covered lives, pushing total national PENFS coverage above 120 million lives), before settling back to around $5.90-$6.00 by September 19 (52-week range $2.21-$9.33). The dominant near-term narrative is payer-driven commercial ramp: Q2 2026 revenue grew 116% YoY to $1.93M on 85.9% gross margin, management guided to $7-8M in FY2026 revenue at the September 15 iAccess Alpha conference, and the next visible catalysts are the September 29-30 Lytham Partners investor conference and an expected early-November Q3 earnings report, alongside an ongoing VA hospital-channel sales force build-out.
